root_idea.summary: The root contains two lexically independent branches: reproach or charging someone with wrongdoing, and the thin layer of fat covering the stomach and intestines of a ruminant.
root_idea.development: The reproach branch yields تَثْرِيبٌ, especially the Quranic denial of blame. The bodily branch yields the noun ثَرْبٌ and related uses for removing or acquiring this fat, as well as several derived descriptions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested verbal noun is presented under its normalized citation form تَثْرِيبٌ.

senses.definition: Reproach, reproof, or upbraiding for a fault or sin.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the term appears in لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ, denying blame or severe reproach for wrongdoing.

senses.definition: In the Quranic denial formula, the absence of evil or mischief, or the non-mentioning of past offenses.
senses.usage_conditions: This construction-specific interpretation applies to لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ and explains renderings that emphasize the absence of harm or the withholding of reproach rather than the word blame alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strip something of its ثَرْب, the thin fat covering the stomach of a ruminant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended usage is to strip a sick person of his garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Removal of the ثَرْب, the thin fat covering the stomach of a ruminant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the bodily, non-reproach sense of the verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blaming or reproving with punishment or chastisement for an offense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical extension of reproach that includes punitive treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame or reprove severely; to reproach or upbraid someone for an offense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related construction ثَرَّبَ عَلَيْهِ and related forms are used for reproaching someone with or reminding them of a fault.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Acting ill or corruptly; doing evil or mischief; creating confusion or disorder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical usage distinct from reproach and from the bodily sense of removing fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To increase in fatness or acquire a ثَرْب.
A thin layer of fat covering the stomach of a ruminant and the bowels or intestines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plurals include ثُرُوبٌ, أَثْرُبٌ, and أَثَارِبُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tract of land whose stones are white like those of a ḥarrah.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant form ثَرِبَاتٌ is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep with a large ثَرْب; hence, a fat sheep.
One who gives little while reproaching the recipient for what he has given.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the active-participial designation corresponding to the reproach branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who acts ill or corruptly, does evil or mischief, or creates confusion and disorder.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Fat-removal sense of the Form I verb.
Extended garment-stripping use is included in the target conditions.
Contains the Quran-attested reproach construction, its reported interpretations, punitive reproach, and related verb uses.
A reported well-building sense is explicitly suspected to be a mistranscription for تَثْوِيبٌ.
Noun for the thin fat covering.
Contains both the upbraiding and corrupting agent-noun branches.

cautions: The sole Quranic occurrence is a verbal noun in the fixed expression لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ; the bodily and other derived uses are broader Classical Arabic evidence, not additional Quranic attestations.
The Quranic construction has reported interpretive emphases on both the denial of reproach and the denial of harm or mention of offenses.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: A reported Lane sense equating تَثْرِيبٌ with building or casing a well is left unassigned because the passage itself suspects a transcription error for تَثْوِيبٌ.

The Mufradat discussion tentatively connects يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ in 33:13 to this root by treating the initial yāʾ as extra; no supplied QAC form or secure lexical assignment permits presenting this as a Quranic root sense.
